issues.current_text: Mais de 700 funcionários do Google assinaram carta a Sundar Pichai pedindo que a empresa rejeite trabalhos sigilosos para os militares.
issues.previous_text: Mais de 600 funcionários — incluindo mais de 20 diretores e vice-presidentes do DeepMind e do Cloud — assinaram carta aberta a Sundar Pichai exigindo que o Pentágono seja impedido de usar a IA do Google em trabalhos sigilosos. É o maior protesto interno em anos, ecoando o Projeto Maven de 2018.
issues.suggestion: The petition was already the lead of yesterday's Google section. Today's angle is the Google-Pentagon contract itself — the employee protest is stale context. Either cut the sentence entirely or compress to a dependent clause: 'apesar de protestos internos que já reúnem mais de 700 assinaturas'. Don't re-tell the same story as if new.

issues.current_text: O barril de Brent se mantém acima de US$111, mais de 50% acima do preço pré-guerra, impulsionado pelo fechamento do Estreito de Ormuz
issues.previous_text: O Brent se mantém acima de US$100 por barril
issues.suggestion: Nearly identical construction ('Brent se mantém acima de $X') used two days apart. Reframe: give the price as a fact without the 'se mantém' formula, e.g., 'O Brent fechou a US$111 — ainda mais de 50% acima do nível pré-guerra.' Or fold the price into the UAE story as context rather than a standalone observation.

issues.current_text: assinaram carta a Sundar Pichai pedindo que a empresa rejeite trabalhos sigilosos para os militares
issues.previous_text: assinaram carta aberta a Sundar Pichai exigindo que o Pentágono seja impedido de usar a IA do Google em trabalhos sigilosos
issues.suggestion: Same syntactic template: '[N] funcionários assinaram carta a Sundar Pichai [verbo] que [Pentágono/empresa] [ação] trabalhos sigilosos'. If the protest stays, rewrite the structure entirely — e.g., lead with the number as an update: 'O número de signatários chegou a 700.'

issues.current_text: Separadamente, a FIDO Alliance, consórcio que define padrões de autenticação digital, criou dois grupos de trabalho
issues.previous_text: Separadamente, a Tokyo Electron cortou laços com o executivo que liderava suas operações na China
issues.suggestion: 'Separadamente' as a paragraph-level transition was used two days ago. Vary: 'Em outro flanco,' 'Num desdobramento paralelo,' or simply start the sentence without a transition word.

issues.current_text: O Google assinou contrato com o Departamento de Defesa dos EUA para uso do Gemini em projetos sigilosos — terceiro fornecedor de IA, depois de OpenAI e xAI, a preencher o espaço deixado pela Anthropic, colocada na lista negra há dois meses.
issues.previous_text: Mais de 600 funcionários — incluindo mais de 20 diretores e vice-presidentes do DeepMind e do Cloud — assinaram carta aberta a Sundar Pichai exigindo que o Pentágono seja impedido de usar a IA do Google em trabalhos sigilosos.
issues.suggestion: The Pentagon-AI narrative is running for the second consecutive day. Yesterday it was framed as employee dissent; today as corporate contract. The angle is different, but readers who saw yesterday's edition already know the context. Acknowledge continuity explicitly ('Depois do protesto de mais de 600 funcionários revelado ontem, o Google formalizou...') rather than presenting it as if the reader is seeing the Pentagon-AI dynamic for the first time.

issues.current_text: Biotech section as final section of the newsletter
issues.previous_text: Biotech section as final section in all four editions (Apr 26, 27, 28, 29)
issues.suggestion: Biotech has closed every edition for four straight days. Consider moving it mid-newsletter or opening with it when the story is strong enough (the pancreatic cancer detection is arguably front-page caliber). Structural predictability makes readers skim the ending.

summary: Main issue: the Google-Pentagon employee protest is essentially retold from yesterday with an updated number (600→700). Oil price phrasing ('Brent se mantém acima de') is recycled verbatim. Structural repetition in section ordering (Biotech always last). Overall repetition level: moderate — one clear story overlap, two phrasing echoes, one structural pattern.
